activities.name: Copy Users
activities.description: src_crm_users â€” raw systemuser entity pull (APAC scope)

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT s.systemuserid AS UserKey, s.[fullname] AS UserName, s.domainname AS UserUPN, s.isdisabledname AS UserStatus, s.islicensedname AS LicensStatus, s.caltypename AS LicenseType, s.territoryidname AS Region, s.businessunitidname AS BusinessUnit, s.rs_profitcentername AS ProfitCenter, w.Rs_segmentlobname AS SegmentLob, w.[rs_businessname] AS BusinessName, s.rs_officename AS OfficeName, office.rs_countryname AS OfficeCountry, s.createdon AS CreatedDate, s.modifiedon AS ModifiedDate FROM systemuser s LEFT JOIN rs_workers w ON w.rs_upn = s.domainname LEFT JOIN rs_office office ON office.[rs_officeid] = s.[rs_office] WHERE s.territoryidname IN ('Asia', 'Australasia')

SELECT DISTINCT a.accountid AS AccountKey, a.accountnumber AS GCID, a.createdon AS CreateDate, a.modifiedon AS ModifiedDate, a.name AS AccountName, a.parentaccountidname AS ParentAccountName, a.rs_ultimateglobalparentname AS GlobalParentAccountName, a.rs_dunsnumber AS DunsNumber, a.rs_clientsegmentationname AS Tiers, a.rs_industryname AS Industry, a.rs_primarysiccodename AS PrimarySICCode, a.rs_address1countryname AS Country FROM account a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN opportunity o WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.accountid = o.parentaccountid LEFT JOIN systemuser s WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.ownerid = s.systemuserid LEFT JOIN rs_office office WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.rs_office = office.rs_officeid WHERE o.statuscodename NOT IN ('Duplicate Entry', 'Expiration no activity') AND (COALESCE(o.rs_regionname, office.rs_subregionname, s.territoryidname) IN ('Asia', 'Australasia', 'India', 'Vietnam', 'China', 'Australia', 'New Zealand') OR s.domainname = 'christopher.au@willistowerswatson.com')

SELECT rs_productclassid AS ProductClassKey, createdon AS CreateDate, modifiedon AS ModifiedDate, rs_name AS ProductName, rs_segmentname AS Segment, rs_businessname AS Business, statecodename AS Status FROM rs_productclass ORDER BY rs_name ASC

SELECT [rs_profitcenterid] AS ProfitcenterKey, [createdon] AS Createdon, [modifiedon] AS Modifiedon, [statecodename] AS Statename, [rs_name] AS ProfitCenter, [rs_financelevel1name] AS Financelevel, [owningbusinessunitname] AS OwningBusinessName, [rs_businessname] AS BusinessName, [rs_lobname] AS LobName, [rs_segmentname] AS Segment FROM [dbo].[rs_profitcenter]

activities.name: Copy Tags
activities.description: Copy Tags List â€” replaces Tags Refresh Dataflow

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tag.rs_name) AS TagKey, tag.rs_tagslistid AS TagID, tag.rs_name AS TagName, CASE WHEN tag.rs_name LIKE '%CRB%' THEN 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING' WHEN tag.rs_name LIKE '%ICT%' THEN 'INSURANCE CONSULTING AND TECHNOLOGY' WHEN tag.rs_name LIKE '%W&R%' THEN 'WORK & REWARDS' WHEN tag.rs_name LIKE '%H&B%' THEN 'HEALTH & BENEFITS' WHEN tag.rs_name LIKE '%INV%' THEN 'INVESTMENTS' WHEN tag.rs_name LIKE '%RET%' THEN 'RETIREMENT' ELSE NULL END AS LOB, tag.rs_tagcategorizationname AS TagType, 1 AS IsActive FROM rs_tagslist tag WHERE tag.statuscodename = 'ACTIVE' AND (tag.rs_name IN ('Large Account - Asia - International - R&B - CRB', '#AsiaTMOs', 'Global Standards - APAC CRB - International - R&B - CRB', 'Global Standards - APAC ICT - International - R&B - ICT', 'Global Standards - APAC W&R - International - HWC - W&R', 'AUNZ CRB Large Accounts - International - R&B - CRB', 'International Industries AFB Tag') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM systemuser s1 WHERE s1.systemuserid = tag.createdby AND s1.domainname IN ('naziya.begum@willistowerswatson.com','vridhi.taneja@willistowerswatson.com')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rs_lead_rs_tagslist ltag INNER JOIN lead l ON l.leadid = ltag.leadid INNER JOIN systemuser s ON s.systemuserid = l.createdby WHERE ltag.rs_tagslistid = tag.rs_tagslistid AND s.domainname IN ('naziya.begum@willistowerswatson.com','millie.nanagara@towerswatson.com'))) ORDER BY tag.rs_name

activities.name: Copy Tags_Accounts
activities.description: Copy Account-Tag Bridge â€” direct + parent + global parent inheritance

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY accountid, TagID) AS BridgeKey, accountid AS AccountID, TagID, TagSource, 'Account' AS EntityType FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.accountid, tag.rs_tagslistid AS TagID, 'Direct' AS TagSource FROM account a INNER JOIN rs_account_rs_tagslist atl ON atl.accountid = a.accountid INNER JOIN rs_tagslist tag ON tag.rs_tagslistid = atl.rs_tagslistid WHERE tag.rs_name IN ('Large Account - Asia - International - R&B - CRB', '#AsiaTMOs', 'Global Standards - APAC CRB - International - R&B - CRB', 'Global Standards - APAC ICT - International - R&B - ICT', 'Global Standards - APAC W&R - International - HWC - W&R', 'AUNZ CRB Large Accounts - International - R&B - CRB', 'International Industries AFB Tag') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT a.accountid, tag.rs_tagslistid AS TagID, 'Parent' AS TagSource FROM account a INNER JOIN account pa ON a.parentaccountid = pa.accountid INNER JOIN rs_account_rs_tagslist atl ON atl.accountid = pa.accountid INNER JOIN rs_tagslist tag ON tag.rs_tagslistid = atl.rs_tagslistid WHERE pa.accountnumber IS NOT NULL AND tag.rs_name IN ('Large Account - Asia - International - R&B - CRB', '#AsiaTMOs', 'Global Standards - APAC CRB - International - R&B - CRB', 'Global Standards - APAC ICT - International - R&B - ICT', 'Global Standards - APAC W&R - International - HWC - W&R', 'AUNZ CRB Large Accounts - International - R&B - CRB', 'International Industries AFB Tag') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT a.accountid, tag.rs_tagslistid AS TagID, 'Global Parent' AS TagSource FROM account a INNER JOIN account gpa ON a.rs_ultimateglobalparent = gpa.accountid INNER JOIN rs_account_rs_tagslist atl ON atl.accountid = gpa.accountid INNER JOIN rs_tagslist tag ON tag.rs_tagslistid = atl.rs_tagslistid WHERE gpa.accountnumber IS NOT NULL AND tag.rs_name IN ('Large Account - Asia - International - R&B - CRB', '#AsiaTMOs', 'Global Standards - APAC CRB - International - R&B - CRB', 'Global Standards - APAC ICT - International - R&B - ICT', 'Global Standards - APAC W&R - International - HWC - W&R', 'AUNZ CRB Large Accounts - International - R&B - CRB', 'International Industries AFB Tag')) AS AllAccountTags

activities.name: Copy Activity
activities.description: src_crm_activity -- raw activitypointer entity, no joins. regardingobjecttypecodename carries entity type natively. Region/office resolution is Silver. dbt Phase 2: stg_crm__activity.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT activityid, activitytypecodename, subject, regardingobjectid, regardingobjectidname, regardingobjecttypecodename, ownerid, owneridname, owninguser, createdon, createdbyname, modifiedon, modifiedbyname, scheduledstart, scheduledend, actualstart, actualend, statecode, statecodename, prioritycodename FROM activitypointer WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE statecode IN (0, 1)

activities.name: Copy KeyAccounts
activities.description: src_crm_key_accounts -- replaces Account_Goals_GoalsActivity.Dataflow. Key account tag inheritance: subsidiary (parent), subsidiary (global parent), and main accounts.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COALESCE(a.accountnumber, a.name) AS GCID, pa.name AS TaggedAccount, pa.rs_address1countryname AS Country, tag.[rs_name] AS AccountTagList, CASE WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%CRB%' THEN 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING' WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%ICT%' THEN 'INSURANCE CONSULTING AND TECHNOLOGY' WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%W&R%' THEN 'WORK & REWARDS' ELSE 'NONE' END AS Lob, a.name AS AccountName, 'Subsidiary' AS KeyAccountType FROM account a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN account pa WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.parentaccountid = pa.accountid LEFT JOIN rs_account_rs_tagslist atl WITH (NOLOCK) ON atl.[accountid] = pa.accountid LEFT JOIN rs_tagslist tag WITH (NOLOCK) ON tag.[rs_tagslistid] = atl.[rs_tagslistid] WHERE pa.accountnumber IS NOT NULL AND tag.[rs_name] IN ('Large Account - Asia - International - R&B - CRB', '#AsiaTMOs', 'Global Standards - APAC CRB - International - R&B - CRB', 'Global Standards - APAC ICT - International - R&B - ICT', 'Global Standards - APAC W&R - International - HWC - W&R', 'AUNZ CRB Large Accounts - International - R&B - CRB') UNION SELECT COALESCE(a.accountnumber, a.name) AS GCID, gpa.name AS TaggedAccount, gpa.rs_address1countryname AS Country, tag.rs_name AS AccountTagList, CASE WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%CRB%' THEN 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING' WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%ICT%' THEN 'INSURANCE CONSULTING AND TECHNOLOGY' WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%W&R%' THEN 'WORK & REWARDS' ELSE 'NONE' END AS Lob, a.name AS AccountName, 'Subsidiary' AS KeyAccountType FROM account a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN account gpa WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.[rs_ultimateglobalparent] = gpa.accountid LEFT JOIN rs_account_rs_tagslist atl WITH (NOLOCK) ON atl.accountid = gpa.accountid LEFT JOIN rs_tagslist tag WITH (NOLOCK) ON tag.rs_tagslistid = atl.rs_tagslistid WHERE gpa.accountnumber IS NOT NULL AND tag.rs_name IN ('Large Account - Asia - International - R&B - CRB', '#AsiaTMOs', 'Global Standards - APAC CRB - International - R&B - CRB', 'Global Standards - APAC ICT - International - R&B - ICT', 'Global Standards - APAC W&R - International - HWC - W&R', 'AUNZ CRB Large Accounts - International - R&B - CRB') UNION SELECT COALESCE(a.accountnumber, a.name) AS GCID, a.name AS TaggedAccount, a.rs_address1countryname AS Country, tag.[rs_name] AS AccountTagList, CASE WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%CRB%' THEN 'CORPORATE RISK & BROKING' WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%ICT%' THEN 'INSURANCE CONSULTING AND TECHNOLOGY' WHEN tag.[rs_name] LIKE '%W&R%' THEN 'WORK & REWARDS' ELSE 'NONE' END AS Lob, a.name AS AccountName, 'Main' AS KeyAccountType FROM account a WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN rs_account_rs_tagslist atl WITH (NOLOCK) ON atl.[accountid] = a.accountid LEFT JOIN rs_tagslist tag WITH (NOLOCK) ON tag.[rs_tagslistid] = atl.[rs_tagslistid] WHERE tag.[rs_name] IN ('Large Account - Asia - International - R&B - CRB', '#AsiaTMOs', 'Global Standards - APAC CRB - International - R&B - CRB', 'Global Standards - APAC ICT - International - R&B - ICT', 'Global Standards - APAC W&R - International - HWC - W&R', 'AUNZ CRB Large Accounts - International - R&B - CRB')

activities.name: Copy Opportunity
activities.description: src_crm_opportunity -- raw opportunity entity, no joins. Bronze contract for dbt stg_crm__opportunity.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT opportunityid, rs_opportunitynumber, [name], stepname, [description], rs_formname, rs_productclassname, rs_productsubclassname, rs_frequencyname, statuscodename, statecodename, statecode, rs_opportunitytypename, rs_opportunitysubtypename, estimatedvalue, estimatedvalue_base, rs_weightedincome, rs_weightedincome_base, transactioncurrencyid, rs_probabilityname, rs_premium_base, rs_projectstartdate, rs_latestmodifieddate, createdon, actualclosedate, campaignidname, parentaccountid, parentaccountidname, ownerid, owneridname, rs_regionname, rs_officename, rs_office, rs_incomeassignmentprofitcenter1name, rs_incomeassignmentfinancelevel11name, rs_inceptiondate, originatingleadid FROM opportunity WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE statuscodename != 'Duplicate Entry' AND statecode IN (0, 1)

activities.name: Copy OpportunityService
activities.description: src_crm_opportunity_service -- raw rs_opportunityservice entity. Bronze contract for dbt stg_crm__opportunity_service.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT rs_opportunityserviceid, rs_opportunity, rs_opportunityname, rs_lobname, rs_servicename, rs_frequencyname, rs_linevalue, rs_linevalue_base, transactioncurrencyid, rs_officename, rs_office, statecode, createdon, modifiedon FROM rs_opportunityservice WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE statecode = 0

activities.name: Copy IncomeAssignment
activities.description: src_crm_income_assignment -- raw rs_incomeassignment entity. Bronze contract for dbt stg_crm__income_assignment.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT rs_incomeassignmentid, rs_serviceline, rs_colleague, rs_colleaguename, rs_profitcenter, rs_profitcentername, rs_share, rs_share_base, statecode, createdon, modifiedon FROM rs_incomeassignment WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE statecode = 0 OR statecode IS NULL

activities.name: Copy Lead
activities.description: src_crm_lead -- raw lead entity, no joins, no region filter. Replaces ANZ_Leads + APAC Leads_ Dataflows. dbt Phase 2: stg_crm__lead.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT leadid, fullname, firstname, lastname, companyname, emailaddress1, telephone1, mobilephone, subject, [description], leadsourcecodename, industrycodename, sic, annualrevenue, annualrevenue_base, budgetamount, budgetamount_base, numberofemployees, estimatedvalue, estimatedvalue_base, estimatedclosedate, rs_regionname, rs_officename, rs_office, rs_profitcentername, ownerid, owneridname, statecode, statecodename, statuscodename, createdon, modifiedon, originatingleadid FROM lead WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE statecode IN (0, 1)
